cards.say: Value of the seven in five point three zero seven. Seven thousandths, which is zero point zero zero seven.
Value of the three in five point three zero seven. Three tenths, which is zero point three.
Value of the eight in eight million four hundred and fifty thousand two hundred and sixteen. Eight million.
Write three million five hundred thousand in words. Three million, five hundred thousand.

cards.front: How many hundredths make one tenth?
cards.say: How many hundredths make one tenth? ten. zero point one equals zero point one zero equals ten hundredths.

cards.front: How many thousandths make one hundredth?
cards.say: How many thousandths make one hundredth? ten. zero point zero one equals zero point zero one zero equals ten thousandths.

Order smallest to largest: zero point four five, zero point four zero five, zero point five, zero point zero five four. Answer: point zero five four, point four zero five, point four five, point five.
Which is greater, zero point zero nine or zero point one? zero point one. Think of zero point one zero zero and zero point zero nine zero.
What is zero point zero zero one less than three point five? three point four nine nine
What is zero point one more than four point nine five? five point zero five
What is one million minus one? nine hundred and ninety nine thousand nine hundred and ninety nine
Multiply seven point two by one thousand. Seven thousand two hundred. Digits move three places to the left.
Divide twenty three point five by one thousand. Zero point zero two three five. Digits move three places to the right.
zero point four divided by one hundred. zero point zero zero four
zero point zero six times ten. zero point six

cards.back: 6.45. The third decimal place is 2, so round down.
cards.say: Round six point four five two seven to two decimal places. six point four five. The third decimal place is two, so round down.

cards.back: 0.09. The third decimal place is 6, so round up.
cards.say: Round zero point zero eight six five to two decimal places. zero point zero nine. The third decimal place is six, so round up.
Round nineteen point nine six to one decimal place. twenty point zero. nineteen point nine six is closer to twenty point zero than to nineteen point nine.

cards.back: 1,800,000. The ten thousands digit is 4, so round down.
cards.say: Round one million eight hundred and forty nine thousand three hundred to the nearest one hundred thousand. one million eight hundred thousand. The ten thousands digit is four, so round down.

cards.back: 8,000,000. The hundred thousands digit is 4, so round down.
cards.say: Round eight million four hundred and fifty thousand to the nearest million. eight million. The hundred thousands digit is four, so round down.
Which is closer to one: zero point nine or one point zero five? one point zero five. It is zero point zero five away. zero point nine is zero point one away.
Estimate three hundred and ninety eight times twenty one. About eight thousand. four hundred times twenty equals eight thousand.
Estimate four point nine plus seven point one plus three point zero two. About fifteen. five plus seven plus three equals fifteen.

cards.back: The zero on the end of a decimal adds no value. 40 hundredths is the same as 4 tenths.
cards.say: Why does three point four zero equal three point four? The zero on the end of a decimal adds no value. forty hundredths is the same as four tenths.
